name: change-map
title: Change map
description: A code change, such as a pull request, drawn as a diagram of the parts it touches and how they interact. Each part opens its files in a diff viewer, and parts of the interface show screenshots before and after. Comment on a part, an interaction or a line, and approve the change or ask for changes.
use_when: You made or studied a code change with several moving parts, such as a feature across services, modules and screens, and the person should understand how the parts fit together before reading the diff, then approve it or say what to change.

show_diff.title: Show the diff drawer
show_diff.description: Open a review with the diff drawer showing, as you left it last.

card_style.title: Cards
card_style.description: How the map draws each part: with its kind and status in a header and the lines it changes, or as a compact card.

state_direction.title: State diagrams
state_direction.description: Which way a state diagram runs from its first state.

screen_mode.title: Screenshot comparison
screen_mode.description: How a part's screenshots open when it has a before and an after

panel_width.title: Side panel width
panel_width.description: The side panel's width in pixels, as you last dragged it.

shortcuts.does: Open the selected part's first file
Go to the next part or interaction to review
Fit the diagram to the frame
